channel.title: Tunisia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Tunisia, every source cited.

item.title: Tunisia braces for thunderstorms and scattered rain
item.description: The national weather service forecasts localized storms and scattered showers across the country on Friday, October 30, 2026.

item.title: Tunisian journalists' union and women's group pledge cooperation
item.description: The National Syndicate of Tunisian Journalists and the Tunisian Association of Democratic Women met on October 29, 2026, to discuss press freedom.

item.title: Club Africain beats Bizertin 3-2 in Ligue 1
item.description: Espérance de Tunis drew 0-0 with Club Sportif Sfaxien, while Stade Tunisien won 1-0.

item.title: Tunisia energy deficit hits 10.48 billion dinars
item.description: Foreign exchange reserves fell to cover 93 days of imports by October 23, 2026.

item.title: Tunisia podcasts festival returns after three-year break
item.description: The Podcast Days event will feature creators from Algeria and Marseille, celebrating sound creation.
